purpose: Teach: カルロス/奄美/インディアン/南アフリカ/カイロ/ジョニー/日産/西武

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカルロス・ゴーン事件のドキュメンタリーをご覧になったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad watched a documentary about the Carlos Ghosn case.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact observation. Light, conversational opening. Speaking to her son about something his father did—no emphasis, just sharing. A gentle, connecting note.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと奄美に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to Amami with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, direct request with a little eagerness underneath. Child's clear enunciation. No performance—just saying what he wants, with hope. Small pause before 'want' like he's asking something precious.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがインディアン文化の本を貸して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad lent you a book about Native American culture.
lines.style: Gentle, noticing tone. Slightly wondering—like she's remarking on something her husband does without saying it outright. Warm but understated. A soft close on the final syllables.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと南アフリカのドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a documentary about South Africa with Dad.
lines.style: Bright report, eager to share. Quick pace, genuine enthusiasm. Like he's telling her something he's proud of doing together. Small, authentic smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカイロ出張のお土産下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad brought back a souvenir from his Cairo trip.
lines.style: Gentle observation, same warm register as before. A little amused—noticing the pattern of gifts without comment. Soft, natural pacing. Quiet approval underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとジョニー・デップの映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a Johnny Depp movie together.
lines.style: Enthusiastic report, quick and genuine. Eager to share this small piece of time with his father. Natural child's energy—no strain, just happy. Quick tempo.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが日産の新車を購入されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad just bought a new Nissan.
lines.style: Calm observation, slightly more neutral than before. Noticing something tangible. A gentle noting—not excited, not dismissive. Soft, even delivery. Warm but grounded.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと西武ドームで野球観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a baseball game at Seibu Dome.
lines.style: Bright, satisfied report. Genuine warmth in his voice. Like this was a really good day. Full, content tone—proud of the memory he's sharing. Warm close.
